title: Warra Filatamaa Gantoota
intro: Seenaa keessatti ergamtoonni waaqaa dhala namaa gidduu kan deeman yoo ta’u, warri isaanitti dhihoo ta’an tokko tokko ifa adda baasuu dadhabaniiru. Seenaan kun lubbuuwwan lama kanneen raajiitti dhihaachuun isaanii qormaata isaanii ta’e, hambaan isaaniis barumsa yeroo hin qabne ta’e irratti naanna’a.
clues: Bara raajota gurguddoo keessa jiraanne, ta’us iji keenya dhugaa isaan fidaniif cufamee hafe.
Manneen keenya mul’ata waaqaatiin kan guutaman yoo ta’u, garaan keenya garuu ni jabaate.
Dhiirota ummata isaanii akeekkachiisuuf filataman waliin heerumne.
Yeroo adabbiin dhufu, akeekkachiisa sanatti waan qoosneef, doonii keessatti gaaddisa hin barbaanne, rooba gubaa jalaas hin baqanne.
Qur’aana keessatti akka fakkeenyatti warra kafaruuf caqafamne, hariiroon dhiyeenyaa nabiyyii waliin illee akka hin fayyine agarsiisa.
Nuti haadha manaa Nuh fi Luut, kan isaan gantanii fi akkasitti kan itti faradamanidha.

trial.label: Qormaanni isaanii maal ture?
options: Dhaltuu waan ta’aniif raajota komatu turan
Qe’ee isaanii gad dhiisanii akka bahan Ibliisiin qoramaniiru

outcome.label: Xumurri isaanii maal ture?
options: Isaanis gara saree fi allaattii jijjiiraman

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
